definitions: Used to indicate that two things are essentially identical or have the same effect, despite minor differences.
An expression of agreement that a distinction being made is trivial or nonexistent.
examples: You say tomato, I say tomahto, same thing.
Whether you pay with cash or card, it's the same thing in the end.
He called it a mistake, I called it an oversight; same thing.
synonyms: six of one, half a dozen of the other
